name: Longer Laser B1 40W
tagline: 40W Longer's large-format diode — bigger bed than Ray5 for sign-sized projects
tldr: Longer Laser B1 40W is the 40W SKU on the Longer longer laser b1 line. Longer's large-format B1 20W diode — this profile is the 20W SKU only; Longer also sells 30W and 40W B1 machines separately. Verify optical power on the listing — do not assume combined-watt marketing.
mainObjective: Fast hobby engraving and cutting — thicker basswood, dark acrylic, and shorter job times

priceRange.note: 40W optical module — verify SKU before buying

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Large work area for the price
Extension kits for even larger jobs
cons: Open frame — not family-safe without enclosure
Longer support community smaller than Ortur
Build quality varies vs premium brands
beginnerNotes: Choose 40W if it matches your typical jobs. Compare cut depth and price against other tiers in this product line before ordering.
proTips: The B1's value is bed size — design templates to use the full width for batch engraving. Add honeycomb and air assist before pushing 8 mm+ cuts.
primaryUse: Large-format diode engraving and thin-to-medium wood cutting for hobbyists and light sellers.
